sanskrit: arvāg anyo divas pṛṣṭhād ito 'nyaḥ pṛthivyā agnī sameto nabhasī antareme | tayoḥ śrayante raśmayo 'dhi dṛḍhās tān ā tiṣṭhati tapasā brahmacārī ||
english: One fire is on this side, below the back of heaven; another is here, above the earth — the two meet in the midspace between the two worlds. Upon them the firm rays are arrayed; the brahmacārī ascends to them by means of his austerity.

sanskrit: abhikrandann aruṇaḥ śitiṅgo bṛhacchepo 'nu bhūmau jabhāra | brahmacārī siñcati sānau retaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tena jīvanti pradiśaś catasraḥ ||
english: Ruddy and dark-necked, great-membered, roaring — he bore his seed along upon the earth. The brahmacārī pours seed upon her ridge; by that the four quarters live upon the earth.

sanskrit: parjanyo mṛtyur varuṇaḥ soma oṣadhayaḥ payaḥ | jīmūtā āsan satvānas tair idaṃ svar ābharan ||
english: Parjanya, Mṛtyu, Varuṇa, Soma, the herbs, and the milk — these were the mighty ones, the vigorous beings; by them they brought forth this heavenly light.

sanskrit: agnau sūrye candramasi mātariśvani brahmacāry apsu samidham ā dadhāti | teṣām arcīṃṣi pṛthag abhre caranti teṣām ājyaṃ puruṣo varṣam aśvaḥ ||
english: In Agni, in Sūrya, in the moon, in Mātariśvan, in the waters — the brahmacārī places the fuel-offering. Their flames move separately in the cloud; their clarified butter is Man, their horse is the rain.

sanskrit: amā ghṛtaṃ kṛṇute kevalam ācāryo bhūtvā varuṇo yadyad aicchat prajāpatau | tad brahmacārī prāyacchat svān mitro adhy ātmanaḥ ||
english: He renders the clarified butter pure at home; having become the ācārya, whatever Varuṇa desired from Prajāpati — that the brahmacārī delivered; Mitra from his own self bestowed it.

sanskrit: ācāryo brahmacārī brahmacārī prajāpatiḥ | prajāpatir vi rājati virāḍ indro 'bhavad vaśī ||
english: The ācārya is the brahmacārī; the brahmacārī is Prajāpati. Prajāpati reigns supreme; Virāj became Indra, the sovereign.

sanskrit: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā rājā rāṣṭraṃ vi rakṣate | ācāryo brahmacaryeṇa brahmacāriṇam icchate ||
english: By brahmacarya and austerity the king protects his realm. By brahmacarya the ācārya seeks out the brahmacārī.

sanskrit: brahmacaryeṇa kanyā yuvānaṃ vindate patim | anaḍvān brahmacaryeṇa- -aśvo ghāsaṃ jigīrṣati ||
english: By brahmacarya a maiden wins a young husband. The draft-ox, by brahmacarya, and the horse strive to obtain their fodder.

sanskrit: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā devā mṛtyum apājayan | indro ha brahmacaryeṇa- -amṛtaṃ svar ābharat ||
english: By brahmacarya and austerity the gods drove away Death. Indra indeed by brahmacarya brought forth the immortal heavenly light.

sanskrit: oṣadhayo bhūtā bhavyam ahorātre vanaspatayaḥ | saṃvatsaraḥ sahartubhis te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
english: The herbs, what has been and what shall be, day and night, the forest trees, the year together with its seasons — these were born as brahmacārīs.

sanskrit: pārthivā divyāḥ paśava āraṇyā grāmyā ca ye | apakṣāḥ pakṣiṇaś ca ye te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
english: The cattle of the earth and of the sky, those of the forest and those of the village, and those without wings and those winged — these too were born as brahmacārīs.

sanskrit: pṛthak sarve prajāpatyāḥ prāṇām̐ ātmasu bibhrati | sarvāṃs tān brahma rakṣati brahmacāriṇy ābhṛtam ||
english: All beings of Prajāpati, each separately, bear the vital breaths within themselves. Brahman, sustained in the brahmacārī, protects all of them.

sanskrit: brahmacārī brahma bhrājad bibharti tasmin devā adhi viśve sametāḥ | sa snāto babhruḥ piṅgalaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bahu rocate ||
english: The brahmacārī bears the blazing brahman; in him all the gods have assembled together. He, the snātaka — tawny and ruddy-brown — shines brilliantly upon the earth.

sanskrit: devānām etat pariṣūtam anabhyārūḍhaṃ carati rocamānam | tasmin sarve paśavas tatra yajñās tasminn annaṃ saha devatābhiḥ ||
english: This, pressed out by the gods, unascended, moves resplendently. In him are all cattle, in him the sacrifices, in him food together with the divine powers.

sanskrit: prāṇāpānau janayann ād vyānaṃ cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ janayan brahma medhām | vācaṃ śreṣṭhāṃ yaśo asmāsu dhehy ||
english: Generating prāṇa and apāna, then vyāna, generating sight and hearing, O brahman, and intelligence — set in us the highest speech and glory.

sanskrit: annaṃ reto lohitam udaraṃ tāni kalpan | brahmacārī salilasya pṛṣṭhe tapo 'tiṣṭhat tapyamānaḥ samudre ||
english: Food, seed, blood, and the womb — shaping these, the brahmacārī stood performing austerity upon the back of the waters, glowing with heat in the ocean.
